blocks.content: ⏰ *Status note: the digital-fraud compensation framework (Feb item + this March directions cluster) — finalised, but implementation has been **deferred twice**, now targeted 1 January 2027 (not April 2026 as originally drafted). See consolidated Status Check.*

items: **A) 2FA mandatory from April 1, 2026** for digital payments (cards/UPI/wallets); cross-border card-not-present transactions get same rule from **October 1, 2026**
**B) DigiLocker verification** for high-risk transactions, mandatory for banks from April 1, 2026

**C) 🔄 Draft customer-protection rules** (RBI Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct Third Amendment Directions, 2026), applicable from **July 1, 2026**: small-value fraud (≤₹25,000 loss) gets 85% compensation or ₹25,000 (whichever less) — this is the *implementing directions* for the Feb fraud-compensation framework
**D) IDPIC** (Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation) — Section 8 company, incorporated 16/10/2025, real-time AI/ML fraud detection
**E) MuleHunter.AI** — mule-account detection, live in 26 banks
**F) Digital Payment Awareness Week (6th edn)**, 9-13 March 2026, theme "Har Payment Digital"; campaign "Thoda Dhyan Se"
**G) RBI won 'Initiative of the Year'** (13th Central Banking Awards, London) for **.bank.in** domain — India 1st country to mandate a dedicated banking internet domain; IDRBT sole registrar

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — 2FA deadline (Apr 1) vs cross-border CNP deadline (Oct 1) date-trap; ".bank.in — world's 1st" standalone fact.
